title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11

ai_review.summary: Raw mono audience recording captures an epic Dark Star → Spanish Jam → Lovelight jam with all‑star guests, delivering a solid and exciting listening experience.
ai_review.review: The AUD source is surprisingly clear and crunchy despite being mono, letting the massive guest‑filled Dark Star > Spanish Jam > Lovelight sequence shine. Reviewers rave about the added guitars from Peter Green, Allmans, Duane Allman, Danny Kirwan, Butch Trucks and Berry Oakley, calling it a must‑have for fans, while noting the absence of the opening Not Fade Away and Cumberland.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4–5 stars) and praise both the performance—especially the guest‑laden Dark Star jam—and the surprisingly good raw audience sound, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono audience source; raw and crunchy but clear enough. No major drop‑outs, though early songs (Not Fade Away, Cumberland) are missing from the capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The highlight is an extended, guest‑filled Dark Star sequence that creates a high‑energy centerpiece; missing opening numbers slightly affect overall flow but the performance remains compelling.
